descriptions.f3b_direction_angles_800e9204: Compute the negative arcsine of the input middle component into output offset 0 and clear output offset 8. Copy the input, clear its middle component, normalize when its squared length is positive, and derive output offset 4 from the arcsine of the normalized first component, adjusted by the original half-turn constant when the input third component is negative. Otherwise use object offset 40. Angle roles are inferred.
